source.name: web-design-rules-and-guidelines
source.license: none declared: nothing is copied; source_rule is a short paraphrase in our own words

status_values.covered: the DSX already states the rule (knowledge, pattern or automated rule)
status_values.partial: the DSX states part of it, or states it without verification where verification is feasible
status_values.not_covered: nothing in the DSX says it

summary: The repository is a visual design guide for websites (landing pages, brand) organized by ingredients and personalities. For operational products, almost everything on typography, color, spacing, hierarchy and usability rules is already in the DSX; personality and decorative imagery are out of product scope (the DSX treats them as the brand register). The gaps that matter for products became proposals: a single icon set, action icons with labels, justified or long centered text, animation duration and a reserved link color.

items.source_rule: Good design conveys trust and perceived value; bad design makes the product look careless
Decisions for each visual ingredient depend on the personality chosen for the site
items.proposal: The DSX uses the product register (operational, consumer, editorial, brand) instead of personality; for products, nothing to add.

items.source_rule: Choose popular, proven fonts instead of taking risks
Use one font family per page, two at most
Limit font sizes to a defined scale
Body text between 16 and 32 px; long-form text larger
Headings can be very large and heavy depending on the personality
Do not use weights below regular
Fewer than 75 characters per line
Line height around 1.5 for body text and tighter for large text
Tighten letter spacing on large headings
Uppercase only for short, small headings with wider letter spacing
Generally do not justify text
items.proposal: Automated rule in the layout family (next free id, L10): running-text block with text-align justify, sev 1. The capture-from-code capture serializes the computed CSS, so it is measurable.

items.source_rule: Do not center long blocks of text
items.proposal: Same rule L10: centered running text longer than 3 lines, sev 1.

items.source_rule: The primary color matches the personality and carries meaning
Use shades picked from a palette, not random colors or CSS named colors
Palette with at least one primary color and one gray, each with light and dark shades
Use the primary color to draw attention to what matters most
Use color to highlight whole sections or components
On dark backgrounds, text in a light shade of the background itself; text never pure black
Minimum contrast of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text
Use images only when they reinforce the message; prefer originals to generic stock photos
items.proposal: Out of scope for operational products (brand register). Nothing to add.

items.source_rule: Show real people to evoke emotion; crop and combine photos and illustrations
Text over an image: darken it, use a neutral area or a box
Images at twice the displayed resolution, compressed
Side-by-side images share the same dimensions
items.proposal: Knowledge addition in knowledge/design-system/spacing-and-layout.md (thumbnails and avatars in the same list with a fixed aspect ratio). Low value as an automated rule.

items.source_rule: Use one good icon set and only one, without mixing
items.proposal: Knowledge addition (Icons section in knowledge/design-system/components.md) and automated rule in the consistency family (next free id, C4): more than one icon library in the captures (MuiSvgIcon classes with data-testid from different packages, or SVGs with incompatible stroke and fill), sev 1.

items.source_rule: Icons as vectors, never bitmaps
Icon weight, roundness and fill match the typography
items.proposal: Goes into the same knowledge addition on icons (one decision in DESIGN.md: outlined or filled, stroke width).

items.source_rule: Action icons carry a label, unless space is lacking or the icon is unambiguous
items.proposal: Could become an automated rule in the screen or layout family: icon-only button outside a toolbar with no visible label on an infrequent action (sev 1); today only the accessible name is checked, indirectly.

items.source_rule: Neutral icons use the text color; another color only to draw attention
An icon must make sense for the text or action it accompanies
Do not scale an icon beyond the size it was designed for
items.proposal: Knowledge addition on icons (sizes 16/20/24 from the scale).

items.source_rule: Shadows only when they make sense, sparingly and light
Shadow size proportional to the element's distance from the interface
Border radius follows the personality and is consistent with the font's roundness
Space conveys relationship; more space between sections than between groups and elements
Within groups, prefer space over divider lines
The more related, the closer together (proximity)
Spacing in fixed multiples of a base unit
Hierarchy defines what matters and the eye's path, using position, size, color, space, border and shadow
The most important content near the top
Images draw a lot of attention; use them carefully
De-emphasize secondary content (labels, metadata) to highlight the primary
Highlight a component by de-emphasizing the others instead of boosting its emphasis
UX aligns the person's goal with the business goal
Do not invent complicated layouts; use patterns people already know
The call to action is the most prominent element and has descriptive text
Blue and underline reserved for links
items.proposal: Automated rule in the consistency family (C5): underlined or link-colored text that is neither a link nor a button, or an inline link in body text with no cue other than color, sev 1.

items.source_rule: Animation with a purpose and fast, between 200 and 500 ms
items.proposal: Verifiable in code (durations outside the motion.* tokens) by tools/lint-raw-values.mjs; today it checks px, not ms. Proposed addition to the raw-values linter.

items.source_rule: In forms, labels and fields aligned on a single vertical line
Feedback for every action: form errors and success
Action buttons near where they take effect (locality)
Main heading descriptive, with the keyword, no flourish
Only relevant information; cut the filler
Plain words, no technical jargon
Break up long text with subheadings, lists and quotes
items.proposal: Automated rule in the layout family (L11): running-text block over ~120 words with no subheading or list, sev 1. Rare in operational products; low priority.

items.source_rule: Define who it is for and why, with business and user goals
Plan content, sitemap and sections before designing
Sketch layout and components iteratively before building
Test on real browsers and devices, optimize images, fix accessibility and performance
After launch, measure usage and keep content up to date
Fluid layout, relative units and flexible images
Media queries at defined breakpoints
items.proposal: No automated check exists: captures are taken at a single width. Proposal: have capture-from-code also capture at 375 px and layout.mjs run L4–L8 at both widths.

items.source_rule: Starting with mobile forces a reduction to the essentials
